purpose: Of two operations racing for the same remaining capacity, is exactly one admitted and does the other exit non-zero with no event written?
argv:
BUD=/Users/jack/.t3/worktrees/skills/t3code-159a16ad/docs/research/bounded-discovery-readiness-2026-09-12/scripts/budget.py
python3 "$BUD" contention-ledger.json reserve --id race-A --amount 0.08 --phase pre-freeze --ticket 207 --evidence P09 > race-A.out 2>&1 &
python3 "$BUD" contention-ledger.json reserve --id race-B --amount 0.08 --phase pre-freeze --ticket 207 --evidence P09 > race-B.out 2>&1 &
wait
echo "race-A exit: $(grep -c reservation_delta_usd race-A.out) event line(s)"; cat race-A.out
echo "race-B exit: $(grep -c reservation_delta_usd race-B.out) event line(s)"; cat race-B.out
echo "--- reserve events written to the ledger ---"
python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open(\"contention-ledger.json\"));print(sum(1 for e in d[\"events\"] if e[\"operation\"]==\"reserve\"));print(\"reserved_usd\",d[\"reserved_usd\"])"
